caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking horse with a curved base for rocking, colored primarily in shades of green with red and yellow accents along the edges. The horse's head is gray with some shading to suggest contours, featuring a brown bridle and details around the eye and ears. The seat is elevated and enclosed by a rounded wooden railing supported by vertical spindles, also painted in green with hints of red accent lines. The overall structure appears to be made of wood, with square footrests near the base of the horse's neck and a saddle-like area at the top of the horse's back. The rocking base is prominently arched, and the design includes several supporting beams beneath the seat for stability. The background is blank, emphasizing the object.
title: Hobby Horse
